content:
anya-peopleops: Hey @leo — quick compact manager checklist + Day 1 blocks for the new SWE starting Mon. Paste into calendar.

leo-manager: Thanks! They'll need Slack, GitHub org access, Jira, staging GCP, and a laptop (16GB min, HDMI adapter).

zoe-hr: Pre-Day1: submit hardware + access form. Day1 AM: HR paperwork (30m). Mid: team intros (30m). End Day1: 20m manager sync to set priorities.

irvin-it: For staging access send GCP project id and corporate email. Procurement ETA 4 biz days; we can arrange a loaner for Week 1.

leo-manager: Email is riley.new@redwood.ai, GCP project rwd-staging-swe. Please grant 'repo-write' on backend repo.

buddy-bob: I can be the buddy — will do repo walkthrough and first small PR pair.

zoe-hr: Tiny 30/60/90 (outcome-focused):
- 30d: access + 5 stakeholder intros + one small bugfix shipped
- 60d: own a small feature or experiment end-to-end
- 90d: measurable impact (perf, reliability, or cost) + present to team

onboard-bot: :white_check_mark: Onboarding profile created for riley.new@redwood.ai. Day1 invites sent.

anya-peopleops: Manager action recap: submit access/hardware form (leo), schedule Day2 1:1 and weekly recurring, confirm buddy + first task (leo).
